text:
### Operational KRIs  
| KRI | Target | Action if Exceeded |
|-----|--------|-------------------|
| Account opening errors | <0.5% | Review process, retrain staff |
| System availability | 99.8% | Investigate outage, remediate |
| Reconciliation variance | <£1k daily | Investigate, correct |
| Fraud detection rate | 97%+ | Tune fraud rules, investigate gaps |
| Compliance violations | 0 | Immediate remediation |
| Customer complaints | <2 per 1,000 accounts | Root cause analysis |

raw_entities.name: Operational Risk Policy
raw_entities.description: A policy governing operational risk management through the definition of Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), target thresholds, and mandatory remediation actions when targets are exceeded.

raw_entities.name: Operational Risk
raw_entities.description: The overarching risk category addressed by the monitoring of account opening errors, system availability, reconciliation variances, and compliance violations.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk of fraudulent activity, monitored via the fraud detection rate KRI to ensure gaps are investigated and rules are tuned.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk of regulatory or policy violations, with a target of zero occurrences and a requirement for immediate remediation.

raw_entities.name: Remediation of Account Opening Errors
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to review the process and retrain staff if account opening errors exceed a target of 0.5%.
context: Account opening errors | <0.5% | Review process, retrain staff

raw_entities.name: System Availability Remediation
raw_entities.description: Obligation to investigate outages and remediate issues if system availability falls below the 99.8% target.

raw_entities.name: Reconciliation Variance Correction
raw_entities.description: Requirement to investigate and correct daily reconciliation variances that exceed £1,000.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Detection Rule Tuning
raw_entities.description: Obligation to tune fraud rules and investigate gaps if the fraud detection rate falls below 97%.
context: Fraud detection rate | 97%+ | Tune fraud rules, investigate gaps

raw_entities.name: Immediate Remediation of Compliance Violations
raw_entities.description: Strict requirement for immediate remediation upon the occurrence of any compliance violations (target is 0).

raw_entities.name: Customer Complaint Root Cause Analysis
raw_entities.description: Requirement to perform a root cause analysis if customer complaints exceed 2 per 1,000 accounts.
context: Customer complaints | <2 per 1,000 accounts | Root cause analysis

raw_entities.name: Operational KRI Monitoring
raw_entities.description: The use of Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) to monitor operational health across account opening, system availability, reconciliation, fraud, compliance, and complaints.

raw_entities.name: Staff
raw_entities.description: Staff members who are subject to retraining in the event that account opening error targets are exceeded.
